title: Amsterdammers over misdaad en politie, 1989

descriptions: General opinion about the police of Amsterdam and their surveillance / perceived chance to become a victim / feelings of insecurity in the whole city, in one's own district and in one's own house / actual victimization / opinion of victims and witnesses about the reaction and way of acting of the police after informing of a crime / solved crimes, caught offenders.
